detail.longDescription: Click publish, exhale. Start again. Tomorrow's post doesn't write itself. What are people discussing right now? Dive into analytics, surface trends, reply to 15 DMs. And then you go viral, your sales dashboard goes through the roof—but no more free time for you in the next three weeks. Congratulations?
